name: RunCodeunit
caption: Run Codeunit / Report

configuration.description: What to run: 'Codeunit' or 'Report'. Absent or empty means Codeunit. The editor always writes one of these two. At run time anything whose lowercase is not 'report' runs as a codeunit, and only the exact value 'Codeunit' (or empty) gets the block-list check.
ID of the codeunit or report. Must be a JSON number (a string value fails to read).
Display caption of the object, written by the editor (looked up from the object list). Informational only; never read at run time.

Optional record to pass: a wrapped flat Reference SmartField, e.g. {{trigger_Rec}}. Read from the raw (unsubstituted) configuration. For a codeunit the record is passed to OnRun (the codeunit's TableNo must match); for a report it is passed as the report's data record.

Report request-page parameters as XML (the format BC saves for a report request page). SmartFields inside the XML are resolved before the run. Only used for objectType = Report; empty means a minimal '<ReportParameters />' envelope so the request page is never shown.

rules.check: objectType should be exactly 'Codeunit' or 'Report' (empty = Codeunit). Other spellings run a codeunit (or a report for any case of 'report') and, for codeunits, skip the block-list check. The editor overwrites the value on save, so its 'Unknown objectType' message never appears.
objectId must be a JSON integer; any other value fails while reading the configuration (in the editor and at run time).
objectId must be non-zero. Checked when the step dialog is confirmed (refuses to save); not at publish. Message is 'Codeunit is required.' or 'Report is required.' depending on objectType.
objectType = Codeunit and objectId is on the block-list: 1, 2, 40, 357, 358. Checked when the dialog is confirmed and again at run time ('This codeunit is blocked for AutoFlow. %1').
The codeunit must exist in the environment.
The codeunit's subtype must be Normal (not Test, TestRunner, Install, Upgrade, ...). Not re-checked at run time.
rules.message: Codeunit %1 (%2) has subtype %3; only Normal codeunits are allowed.

rules.check: The report must exist in the environment.
A non-empty sourceRecordSelector must be a wrapped SmartField placeholder {{name}}. Also enforced at run time with 'Source record reference must be a wrapped SmartField placeholder. Got: %1'.
rules.message: Source record reference must be a wrapped SmartField placeholder, e.g. {{customer}}. Got: %1

rules.check: The selector must resolve to a known field in the flow.
rules.message: Source record reference %1 cannot be resolved to a known field.

rules.check: The selector must point at a Reference-typed output, not a Value.
rules.message: Source record reference %1 must point at a Reference-typed field, not a Value.

rules.check: The selector's name must exist as a Reference in the run's SmartField context.
rules.message: Source record reference '%1' could not be resolved at runtime.

rules.check: The passed record must still exist when the worker session starts (looked up by SystemId). Surfaces as the codeunit/report failure message.
rules.message: Source record %1 in table %2 could not be found.

rules.check: The codeunit raised an error (or returned false without a message: 'Codeunit %1 failed without a usable error message. Try invoking the same operation manually from the BC UI to see the underlying validation error.').
The report raised an error (without a message: 'Report %1 failed without a usable error message. Try invoking the same report manually from the BC UI to see the underlying validation error.').
The codeunit/report did not finish within 600 seconds.
rules.message: Codeunit/report did not complete within %1 seconds. Job %2 is still Pending.

notes: Runs the object in a separate background session (its own transaction) and waits for it (polling, max 10 minutes). The step COMMITS the flow's open transaction before starting the session, also inside SubFlows and synchronous/interactive flows.
The object's own changes are committed by the worker session independently of the flow: a later failure of the flow does not roll them back.
Reports run via saved request-page parameters and never show a request page; rendered output is discarded – only side effects matter (use processing-only reports).

The step dialog runs these checks on OK and refuses to save an invalid configuration ('The Run Codeunit/Report configuration is invalid:' + list); publish does not re-run them, so an imported definition is not checked until the step is opened. The block-list check is repeated at run time; subtype and existence are not.
success is always 'true' when the step completes; failures raise an error instead.
The object's own error text is truncated to 1024 characters.
